## Summary
- [ ] Adds/updates chain metadata OR docs
- [ ] Passes local checks (`./gradlew run`, `npx prettier --write _data/*/*.json`)

## Checklist
- [ ] `shortName` and `name` are unique
- [ ] Icons (if used) have IPFS JSON in `_data/icons/` (< 250 KB)
- [ ] Parent chain (if any) already exists
- [ ] CI is green
